I found an issue with `ett_zbee_zcl_sel[]` in this MR. Are you able to have a look at this?

1. The array has 16 elements, but is used in a loop with 64 iterations in `dissect_zcl_read_attr_struct()`. This will easily be a out-of-bounds read.
2. The array is not registered in `proto_register_subtree_array()`. This will give a dissector assert in `proto_item_add_subtree()`.

Do you have a sample capture file we can use for testing?
@deepthimary The out-of-bounds issue was fixed in !13341. Please have a look.
